description: FREE (key) — Use first whenever your user refers to one of their ListPlus lists: it names the lists you may work on and what you may do there. without list_id: the lists shared with you (name, kind, rows, what you may do). With list_id: its columns (content types, allowed values, which you may write), statuses, the sublists you are limited to, the pipelines you may hand records to, the filter conditions, and the tools this list allows. Call it before working on a list.

list_id.description: The list's id (describe_list without list_id shows the lists shared with you)
